integrity.claim_to_evidence: The remaining step is an exact coefficient comparison for the general graded automorphism x->Lx, z->az+h_m(x), forcing h_m=0 from the z^{r-1} coefficient.
integrity.critical_source_input: Theorem 1.7 of arXiv:2610.00130v1 reconstructs a quasismooth weighted general-type hypersurface from its full graded dg matrix-factorization category under the stated coprimality hypothesis.

scientific_limitations: The claim requires the full graded dg matrix-factorization category, not merely the derived category of the cover.
It assumes m>=2, (r-1)m>n+1, gcd(rm,n+1+m)=1, and a smooth branch hypersurface.
No necessity of the arithmetic hypotheses is asserted.
title: General-type cyclic covers are reconstructed together with their branch divisors
